title: Size the line-number gutter to the file's actual digits
reason: The embedded editor reserves at least three character columns for line numbers, leaving unnecessary space before short-file line numbers. The workbench hardcodes lineNumbersMinChars and does not expose it as a user setting or extension API. Lower the minimum to one so the existing editor layout grows the gutter to fit the actual line count, while retaining glyph-margin breakpoints, folding, and change decorations.
validation: Open short and long files in Cantrip Code; verify line numbers use only the columns needed for their digits and gutter controls remain usable
removal: Remove if upstream exposes a supported line-number minimum-width setting or adopts an adaptive one-character minimum.
